```{pyodide}
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    "font.family": "monospace",
    "font.size": 13,
    "figure.facecolor": "#fafafa",
    "figure.dpi": 120,
    "savefig.dpi": 120,
})

COLORS = {
    "match": "#4CAF50",
    "mismatch": "#F44336",
    "current": "#FFC107",
    "skip": "#90CAF9",
    "default": "#E0E0E0",
    "pattern": "#BBDEFB",
    "border": "#7E57C2",
}


def draw_string_row(ax, y, string, label="", highlights=None, offset=0):
    """Draw a row of character boxes at vertical position y."""
    highlights = highlights or {}
    for i, ch in enumerate(string):
        color = highlights.get(i, COLORS["default"])
        rect = mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
            (i + offset, y), 0.9, 0.9,
            boxstyle="round,pad=0.05",
            facecolor=color, edgecolor="#555", linewidth=1.2,
        )
        ax.add_patch(rect)
        ax.text(i + offset + 0.45, y + 0.45, ch,
                ha="center", va="center", fontsize=14, fontweight="bold")
    if label:
        ax.text(offset - 0.3, y + 0.45, label,
                ha="right", va="center", fontsize=12, color="#555")
```

## Naive String Matching

Step through **every single character comparison**.
At each shift `s`, the algorithm compares `P[0]` vs `T[s]`, then `P[1]` vs `T[s+1]`, and so on.
On a mismatch it **backtracks** to the next shift and starts over from `P[0]` — this is the repeated work that makes the naive approach slow.

```{pyodide}
#| autorun: true
#| edit: false
#| output: false

def naive_trace_granular(T, P):
    """One step per character comparison, plus a backtrack step between shifts."""
    steps = []
    n, m = len(T), len(P)
    total_comps = 0
    matches = []
    for s in range(n - m + 1):
        for j in range(m):
            matched = T[s + j] == P[j]
            total_comps += 1
            comps_so_far = [(k, T[s + k] == P[k]) for k in range(j)] + [(j, matched)]
            is_full = matched and j == m - 1
            if is_full:
                matches.append(s)
            steps.append({
                "s": s, "j": j, "matched": matched,
                "comps": comps_so_far,
                "event": "full_match" if is_full else ("match" if matched else "mismatch"),
                "total_comps": total_comps,
                "matches": list(matches),
            })
            if not matched:
                break
        # Add backtrack step (unless this was the last shift)
        if s < n - m:
            steps.append({
                "s": s, "j": -1, "matched": False,
                "comps": [],
                "event": "backtrack",
                "total_comps": total_comps,
                "matches": list(matches),
            })
    return steps


def draw_naive(T, P, step_idx):
    steps = naive_trace_granular(T, P)
    if not steps:
        return
    step_idx = min(step_idx, len(steps) - 1)
    snap = steps[step_idx]
    n, m = len(T), len(P)
    s = snap["s"]
    comps = snap["comps"]
    event = snap["event"]

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 1, figsize=(max(n * 0.85, 10), 4.0))
    ax.set_xlim(-2.5, n + 4.0)
    ax.set_ylim(-1.5, 3.5)
    ax.set_aspect("equal")
    ax.axis("off")

    # Position indices
    for i in range(n):
        ax.text(i + 0.45, 2.9, str(i), ha="center", va="center",
                fontsize=9, color="#999")

    # T row highlights
    t_hi = {}
    for j, matched in comps:
        t_hi[s + j] = COLORS["match"] if matched else COLORS["mismatch"]
    draw_string_row(ax, 1.8, T, label="T", highlights=t_hi)

    # P row highlights
    p_hi = {}
    for j, matched in comps:
        p_hi[j] = COLORS["match"] if matched else COLORS["mismatch"]
    # Highlight current comparison position
    if event in ("match", "mismatch", "full_match"):
        cur_j = snap["j"]
        p_hi[cur_j] = COLORS["current"] if event == "match" else (
            COLORS["match"] if event == "full_match" else COLORS["mismatch"])
        t_hi[s + cur_j] = p_hi[cur_j]
    draw_string_row(ax, 0.5, P, label="P", highlights=p_hi, offset=s)

    # Comparison arrows
    for j, matched in comps:
        color = COLORS["match"] if matched else COLORS["mismatch"]
        if event in ("match", "mismatch", "full_match") and j == snap["j"]:
            color = COLORS["current"] if event == "match" else (
                COLORS["match"] if event == "full_match" else COLORS["mismatch"])
            lw = 2.5
        else:
            lw = 1.2
        ax.plot([s + j + 0.45, s + j + 0.45], [1.8, 1.4],
                color=color, linewidth=lw, alpha=0.7)

    # Status message
    if event == "backtrack":
        status = f"Mismatch! Backtrack: shift s={s} → s={s+1} (start over from P[0])"
        color = "#FF9800"
        # Draw backtrack arrow
        ax.annotate("", xy=(s + 1 + 0.45, 0.1), xytext=(s + 0.45, 0.1),
                     arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-|>", color="#FF9800",
                                     lw=2.5, connectionstyle="arc3,rad=-0.3"))
        ax.text(s + 0.9, -0.5, "backtrack", ha="center", fontsize=9,
                color="#FF9800", fontweight="bold")
    elif event == "full_match":
        status = f"MATCH at position {s}!"
        color = COLORS["match"]
    elif event == "match":
        cur_j = snap["j"]
        status = f"Compare P[{cur_j}]='{P[cur_j]}' vs T[{s+cur_j}]='{T[s+cur_j]}' → match, continue"
        color = COLORS["match"]
    else:  # mismatch
        cur_j = snap["j"]
        status = f"Compare P[{cur_j}]='{P[cur_j]}' vs T[{s+cur_j}]='{T[s+cur_j]}' → MISMATCH"
        color = COLORS["mismatch"]

    ax.text(n / 2, -1.0, status, fontsize=11, color=color,
            ha="center", fontweight="bold")

    ax.set_title(
        f"Step {step_idx + 1}/{len(steps)}  |  shift s={s}  |  "
        f"total comparisons: {snap['total_comps']}  |  "
        f"matches found: {len(snap['matches'])}",
        fontsize=11, pad=8)

    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
```
